title: Agentic AI Engineer
description: Design reliable AI agents that use tools, retrieval, and workflows to complete multi-step tasks.

stages.title: LLM and agent foundations
projects: Build a tool-using assistant with input validation and a clear audit trail.
stages.milestone: Explain agent loops, tool schemas, and safe handling of tool results.

stages.title: Agent orchestration and retrieval
projects: Create a stateful research agent with retrieval, bounded tool permissions, and evaluation cases.
stages.milestone: Demonstrate a tested multi-step agent that recovers safely from tool errors.

stages.title: Production agents and observability
projects: Deploy an agent service with tracing, human approval for sensitive actions, and regression evaluations.
stages.milestone: Present a deployed agent with documented safeguards, cost controls, and evaluation results.

title: AI/ML Engineer
description: Build, evaluate, and deploy machine-learning systems with sound software and data practices.

stages.title: Python, data, and mathematics
projects: Explore and document a public dataset with reproducible Python notebooks.
stages.milestone: Prepare a clean dataset and explain baseline metrics.

stages.title: Modeling and deep learning
projects: Train and compare a supervised model; track experiments and explain errors.
stages.milestone: Ship a validated model with a reproducible training pipeline.

stages.title: Deployment and model operations
projects: Serve a model behind an API with tests, monitoring, and a model card.
stages.milestone: Deploy a monitored model service and document its limitations.

title: Generative AI Engineer
description: Create grounded generative AI applications using language models, retrieval, evaluation, and secure APIs.

stages.title: LLM application foundations
projects: Build a structured-output assistant with input validation and tests.
stages.milestone: Build a working LLM application with predictable output handling.

stages.title: Retrieval and application quality
projects: Build a document Q&A application with citations and a retrieval evaluation set.
stages.milestone: Measure groundedness and improve retrieval using a repeatable test set.

stages.title: Production, safety, and cost
projects: Deploy a monitored RAG service with access controls, fallback behavior, and cost limits.
stages.milestone: Demonstrate production readiness with evaluation, monitoring, and safety documentation.

title: Data Scientist
description: Use statistics, programming, and machine learning to derive useful and defensible insights from data.

stages.title: Statistics and data preparation
projects: Analyze a public dataset and communicate limitations, trends, and data quality.
stages.milestone: Deliver a reproducible exploratory analysis with clear visualizations.

stages.title: Experiments and predictive modeling
projects: Build a predictive model with a baseline, validation strategy, and error analysis.
stages.milestone: Compare models and justify the final model using appropriate metrics.

stages.title: Decision support and delivery
projects: Present a decision-focused analysis and deploy a small inference or dashboard service.
stages.milestone: Explain the analysis to a non-technical audience and recommend a measurable action.

title: Data Engineer
description: Build dependable batch and streaming pipelines that deliver trusted data for analytics and machine learning.

stages.title: SQL and Python data foundations
projects: Design a relational schema and load a versioned public dataset.
stages.milestone: Write tested SQL transformations and explain the data model.

stages.title: Pipelines and orchestration
projects: Create an idempotent scheduled pipeline with validation and failure recovery.
stages.milestone: Run an observable pipeline that handles retries and late-arriving data.

stages.title: Cloud warehouse and governance
projects: Publish a governed analytics dataset and document lineage, access, and freshness.
stages.milestone: Demonstrate a secure, monitored cloud data workflow.

title: Data Analyst
description: Query, clean, and interpret data with SQL, spreadsheets, and dashboards to support business decisions.

stages.title: Data and spreadsheet foundations
projects: Clean a public dataset and answer five clearly stated questions.
stages.milestone: Produce a documented analysis with validated calculations.

stages.title: Dashboards and communication
projects: Build an interactive dashboard with a concise executive summary.
stages.milestone: Present a dashboard that answers a stakeholder question and explains caveats.

title: Backend Developer
description: Design and deliver secure server-side applications, APIs, databases, and integrations.

stages.title: Programming and web fundamentals
projects: Build a small command-line application with tests and persistent data.
stages.milestone: Use version control, tests, and clear interfaces in a working program.

stages.title: APIs and persistence
projects: Build an authenticated REST API with validation, migrations, and integration tests.
stages.milestone: Deliver documented API endpoints with robust error handling.

stages.title: Deployment and reliability
projects: Containerize and deploy an API with health checks, logging, and least-privilege access.
stages.milestone: Explain deployment, monitoring, and security choices for your service.

title: Full-Stack Developer
description: Build complete web applications across responsive interfaces, APIs, databases, and deployment.

stages.title: Frontend foundations
projects: Create an accessible responsive interface with reusable components.
stages.milestone: Build and test a multi-page React interface.

stages.title: Backend and data integration
projects: Connect a frontend to a validated API and a relational database.
stages.milestone: Ship an end-to-end feature with authentication and integration tests.

stages.title: Quality and deployment
projects: Deploy a complete web app with automated tests and operational documentation.
stages.milestone: Present a deployed application with a reliable delivery workflow.

title: SDET / QA Automation Engineer
description: Improve software quality through test strategy, automation, and reliable release validation.

stages.title: Testing fundamentals
projects: Write a risk-based test plan and automate core user journeys.
stages.milestone: Create clear test cases and reproducible defect reports.

stages.title: UI and API automation
projects: Build stable UI and API test suites with reusable fixtures.
stages.milestone: Run automated tests in continuous integration with useful failure reports.

stages.title: Quality engineering at scale
projects: Add a quality gate that measures reliability and prevents a known regression.
stages.milestone: Explain a quality strategy spanning risk, automation, and release confidence.

title: Cloud Engineer
description: Provision and operate secure, scalable cloud infrastructure and application environments.

stages.title: Cloud and networking foundations
projects: Document and diagram a least-privilege cloud network design.
stages.milestone: Explain core cloud services, network boundaries, and identity controls.

stages.title: Infrastructure and automation
projects: Provision a repeatable environment from version-controlled infrastructure code.
stages.milestone: Deploy a containerized service through reproducible infrastructure.

stages.title: Operations and reliability
projects: Add alerts, backups, and a recovery runbook to a sample cloud deployment.
stages.milestone: Demonstrate secure operations and recovery for a deployed workload.

title: DevOps Engineer
description: Automate software delivery and infrastructure while improving deployment reliability and feedback.

stages.title: Linux, scripting, and version control
projects: Automate a repeatable local environment setup with documented checks.
stages.milestone: Troubleshoot a service using logs, processes, and network tools.

stages.title: Containers and delivery pipelines
projects: Create a CI pipeline that tests and deploys a containerized application.
stages.milestone: Deploy an application using an automated, repeatable pipeline.

stages.title: Cloud operations and reliability
projects: Instrument a service and write an incident runbook with recovery steps.
stages.milestone: Demonstrate safe deployment, alerting, and incident response.

title: Cybersecurity Analyst
description: Monitor security signals, investigate incidents, and help protect systems and information.

stages.title: Security and networking fundamentals
projects: Create a home-lab security inventory and document threat scenarios.
stages.milestone: Explain common attack surfaces and foundational defensive controls.

stages.title: Monitoring and incident analysis
projects: Analyze a public benign security dataset and write an evidence-based incident timeline.
stages.milestone: Triage an alert and document evidence, impact, and containment steps.

stages.title: Vulnerability and cloud defense
projects: Build a prioritized remediation report using an authorized lab environment.
stages.milestone: Present a prioritized defensive recommendation with supporting evidence.

title: NLP Engineer
description: Build software that processes, searches, and generates human language.

stages.title: Language processing foundations
projects: Build a text classification or semantic search prototype.
stages.milestone: Evaluate a language task on a documented dataset.

title: Computer Vision Engineer
description: Develop systems that interpret images and video using computer-vision models.

stages.title: Image modeling foundations
projects: Train an image classifier and document its evaluation and failure cases.
stages.milestone: Demonstrate a reproducible computer-vision model.

title: MLOps / LLMOps Engineer
description: Operate reliable machine-learning and language-model systems across training, deployment, and monitoring.

stages.title: Model operations foundations
projects: Automate a model deployment and add basic monitoring.
stages.milestone: Track a model from experiment to monitored service.

title: Business Intelligence (BI) Analyst
description: Turn business data into trusted metrics, dashboards, and actionable reports.

stages.title: BI reporting foundations
projects: Create a dashboard with documented metric definitions.
stages.milestone: Present a reliable dashboard tied to a business question.

title: AI Product Manager
description: Guide AI products from customer need through evaluation, launch, and responsible iteration.

stages.title: AI product foundations
projects: Write a product brief that defines user value and measurable evaluation criteria.
stages.milestone: Present an AI product proposal with risks and success measures.

title: Prompt / AI Application Engineer
description: Build useful applications around foundation models with structured prompts, evaluation, and APIs.

stages.title: Prompt and application foundations
projects: Build a prompt evaluation set and a structured-output application.
stages.milestone: Show measurable prompt quality improvements on a test set.

title: Frontend Developer
description: Create accessible, responsive web interfaces using modern JavaScript frameworks.

stages.title: Responsive interface foundations
projects: Build an accessible responsive dashboard with reusable components.
stages.milestone: Deliver a responsive interface with keyboard navigation.

title: Mobile App Developer
description: Design and build mobile applications for Android, iOS, or cross-platform frameworks.

stages.title: Mobile application foundations
projects: Build a mobile app that consumes an API and handles offline or error states.
stages.milestone: Demonstrate a tested mobile app on an emulator or device.

title: Embedded / IoT Engineer
description: Develop software and connected-device systems for embedded hardware and IoT applications.

stages.title: Embedded systems foundations
projects: Build a sensor prototype with documented firmware and test behavior.
stages.milestone: Demonstrate a connected device prototype and its operating constraints.

title: Cloud Solutions Architect
description: Design secure, resilient, and cost-aware cloud architectures aligned with business requirements.

stages.title: Cloud architecture foundations
projects: Create a cloud architecture diagram with security and recovery decisions.
stages.milestone: Review an architecture against reliability, security, and cost goals.

title: Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)
description: Improve service reliability through observability, automation, incident response, and engineering practices.

stages.title: Reliability engineering foundations
projects: Define service indicators and an incident response runbook for a sample service.
stages.milestone: Use service-level objectives to prioritize reliability work.

title: Platform Engineer
description: Build internal platforms that help development teams deliver software safely and efficiently.

stages.title: Platform engineering foundations
projects: Create a self-service deployment template with sensible guardrails.
stages.milestone: Demonstrate a reusable developer platform capability.

title: Kubernetes / Container Engineer
description: Package, deploy, and operate containerized applications and Kubernetes platforms.

stages.title: Containers and orchestration
projects: Deploy a multi-service application to a local Kubernetes cluster.
stages.milestone: Explain deployment, service discovery, and health checks.

title: Cloud Security Engineer
description: Protect cloud environments through identity, network controls, threat detection, and secure design.

stages.title: Cloud security foundations
projects: Review a sample cloud configuration and prioritize defensive improvements.
stages.milestone: Present a cloud security review with actionable remediations.

title: Ethical Hacker / Penetration Tester
description: Assess systems for security weaknesses within explicit authorization and responsible testing scope.

stages.title: Authorized security testing foundations
projects: Practice only in a local or intentionally vulnerable lab and write a remediation report.
stages.milestone: Demonstrate responsible testing and clear remediation guidance in an authorized lab.

title: SOC Analyst
description: Monitor security operations, triage alerts, and coordinate evidence-based incident response.

stages.title: SOC monitoring foundations
projects: Triage sample security events and document a defensible escalation decision.
stages.milestone: Produce a concise alert triage report with evidence and next steps.

title: Blockchain / Web3 Developer
description: Build decentralized applications and smart contracts with a focus on correctness and security.

stages.title: Smart contract foundations
projects: Build and test a simple contract on a local development network.
stages.milestone: Explain contract behavior and security assumptions.

title: Game Developer
description: Create interactive games using programming, game engines, and iterative design.

stages.title: Game development foundations
projects: Build a small playable game loop with input, scoring, and a restart flow.
stages.milestone: Share a playable prototype and describe its design choices.

title: UI/UX Designer
description: Research user needs and design usable, accessible digital experiences.

stages.title: User-centered design foundations
projects: Prototype a user flow and validate it with a small usability study.
stages.milestone: Present research findings and an accessible interactive prototype.

title: Technical Product Manager
description: Lead technical product direction by aligning customer needs, engineering constraints, and measurable outcomes.

stages.title: Technical product foundations
projects: Write a product requirements brief for an API-based feature with measurable outcomes.
stages.milestone: Present a prioritized roadmap that explains technical tradeoffs.

title: Database Administrator (DBA)
description: Maintain database reliability, performance, security, backup, and recovery.

stages.title: Database operations foundations
projects: Set up a database with backup, restore validation, and performance notes.
stages.milestone: Demonstrate tested recovery and explain query performance choices.

title: Business Analyst
description: Translate business needs into clear requirements, process improvements, and measurable outcomes.

stages.title: Requirements and analysis foundations
projects: Document a process, stakeholder needs, and prioritized acceptance criteria.
stages.milestone: Present a validated requirements brief and process improvement proposal.
